notes: C09/F12: Additional rooms may leave cancellation habits or timing mismatches unresolved; unaccommodated requests alone do not establish a capacity shortage.

C18/F20–F22: Full trained-staff coverage and 85% of reservations used or cancelled before their start establish the proposed process conditions. Continued unaccommodated requests in at least four of six weeks despite changes then support considering expansion.
C20/F24: Weak coverage or reliability instead calls for revising the process and reassessing.
C19/F23: Meeting all three conditions supports consideration only. The number of additional rooms needed remains unresolved.
